decision_tools.title: Which providers serve both CFOs and private equity firms?
decision_tools.question: Which providers serve both CFOs and private equity firms?
decision_tools.definition: Organizations must have a CFO role classification plus evidence of a private-equity audience, topic, or industry.
decision_tools.direct_answer: 32 organizations currently meet every documented criterion in this dataset.
decision_tools.method: Intersect the canonical CFO cohort with evidence-backed private-equity fields.
decision_tools.caveat: This is an evidence-backed dataset result, not a recommendation. Missing evidence remains unknown rather than false.
